programs.title: The Grand Canal Ep.2
programs.desc: With the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal as longitude and its 3,000-year history as latitude, this series traces the canal's development from multiple angles, tells the life stories of those along its banks, and reveals the unique status of this world cultural heritage.

programs.desc: This documentary traces the life of the Song dynasty scientist Shen Kuo, highlighting his remarkable achievements in astronomy, geography and physics, while connecting the threads of scientific knowledge across ancient and modern times.
